retained_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: count RNA nucleotide or ambiguity letters in native aligned row

model_match_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: count nucleotide letters at RF consensus positions

model_gap_positions.formula_or_native_source: count - . _ at RF consensus positions; includes unvisited positions, not automatically D states

missing_model_positions.formula_or_native_source: count native sequence ~ at RF consensus positions; does not include RF ~ EL columns

nonresidue_model_positions.formula_or_native_source: count native sequence * at RF consensus positions; not an observed nucleotide

retained_insert_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: count nucleotide letters at RF . - _ IL/IR columns

retained_local_end_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: count nucleotide letters at RF ~ EL columns

deleted_model_positions.formula_or_native_source: model_gap_positions only with explicit global and notrunc, no submodel truncation, no native contradiction, and validated model geometry

local_end_skipped_model_positions.formula_or_native_source: zero in explicit global nontruncated mode; local mode unavailable without traceback

total_insert_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: full output: retained insert count; matchonly: sum validated --ifile emission counts

total_local_end_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: full output: retained EL count; matchonly: sum validated --elfile emission counts; global zero

omitted_nucleotides.formula_or_native_source: count validated disjoint original positions removed by match-only rendering

original_length.formula_or_native_source: agreement of supplied actual sequence length, declared length and associated native lengths

model_length.formula_or_native_source: supplied model CLEN or unambiguous sidecar model header, checked against all RF consensus columns

native_bit_score.uncertainty: printed to two decimal places; model score, not function correctness

native_avg_pp.uncertainty: rounded to three decimals; conditional on banding/truncation mode

posterior_lower_mean.uncertainty: native quantization interval, conditional on banding/truncation; not exact posterior or annotation correctness

posterior_upper_mean.uncertainty: native quantization interval, conditional on banding/truncation; not exact posterior or annotation correctness

posterior_counts_and_bins.uncertainty: upper mean endpoint closed only when every bin is *

column_occupancy.missing_behavior: null_for_zero_denominator; missing/nonresidue/unavailable rows excluded and separately counted

native_pp_cons_bounds.formula_or_native_source: same native PP quantization bins; native population not inferred

canonical_pair_fraction.uncertainty: consistency with supplied model alignment only, not experimental structure or function

pair_counts.formula_or_native_source: observed_two_nucleotide_pairs=canonical+noncanonical+ambiguous; disjoint exclusions use missing then gap then nonresidue then unavailable then ambiguous precedence

timing.formula_or_native_source: native --sfile band calc/alignment/total seconds and mem (Mb); no inference about queue wait or biological confidence
timing.uncertainty: native printed precision .01; matrix MB is native dynamic-programming matrix allocation estimate

native_coordinates_and_index.formula_or_native_source: native input-file sequence index and model alignment boundaries; -1 sentinel retained when no occupied position

summary_counts.formula_or_native_source: count records or sum explicit pair/column counts in selected population; does not assert independence
